coordinate_frame: Existing captured housing datum; adapters apply installed transforms exactly once
unresolved: Configured strict cross-fit checks cover selected integration, not every component pair. Frozen local seating and terminal evidence remains required.
Receiving allowances are not supplier-certified geometry; exact part/connector dimensions and physical qualification remain open.
Magnet,grub screw and actual spring coil lack separate installed source models; sensor registry records these omissions.
Remaining panel harness/splice physical routes and whole-board electrical/thermal work remain incomplete.
Default scene is one-piece structural geometry. Use --reservations and --motion for explicitly labeled allowances/sweeps.

Selected ground geometry contains32 wires and1 splice; r22 replaces four scene links with radius18mm bows to free signal terminals. Physical joint preparation, supports, service slack and other panel wiring remain incomplete.

r16 support receiving geometry passes selected assembly checks; support-selector contact uses the frozen scoped local probe. Actual sleeve, PCB/print strength, tool access, retention and full service motion remain unqualified.
r18 positive rotation stops checked as nominal geometry only; PCB edge loading, strength, tolerance, abrasion, axial strain relief and opening remain unqualified.

Wider coverage audit finds overlap between fan wires and their own F_J202/F_J203 general reservations. Bundle-to-individual ownership is corrected with all six paths retained; exact connector receiving envelope and terminal registration remain open; no foreign allocation, cooling structure or shell interference in the tested groups.

Detailed C3 touch model replaces the broad box; actual touch through-fastener stack, host/electrode wiring and physical tolerances remain unqualified. Raw touch/lever/lid shell-seat contacts are retained separately, not waived by non-shell checks.

R26 sourced nominal touch fasteners, two nut-pocket extensions and upper receiving envelope are modeled. Printed/PCB tolerances, fastener conformity, recessed nut insertion, torque, creep and retention remain unqualified; raw seats are not empty passes.

Removable lever handle with sourced nominal cap screw and enlarged operating envelope is modeled; printed threads, tightening/retention, exact tool/hand access, wire flex and full wired-lid removal remain unqualified. The local16mm vertical lift check is not full service qualification.

S01–S13 are receiving routes only;217 remaining panel signal/power segments, terminations, supports and opening flex remain unqualified. Scene-zero holder relief preserves the upper0.5mm bearing layer; printed strength, retention and tolerance remain unqualified.
D101 r125 receiving-envelope gap to A_C105 is0.02mm. Native and modeled noninterference passes do not establish placement/process tolerance; supplier and manufacturing qualification remains open.

Full22main-board nominal screw/washer/nut stacks are modeled under explicit receiving requirements. Underhead fillet/washer mating, screw length/tip conformity, washer registration, nut bearing, torque/creep, printed strength, tools and loaded feet clearance remain unqualified. Bare-board H_NEW5 uses12mm; the unselected cradle needs its separate14mm stack.
